script_provenance: Original benchmark was an inline shell heredoc sent to exec_command; no standalone script file existed at measurement time. See separately saved reconstruction for reproducibility; reconstructed script hash must not be represented as execution-time provenance.
workflow_bootstrap_script_at_measurement:
# The main mode-specific install below already builds the editable
# project. Read this lightweight extra directly so early speech checks
# do not build/install the same project and base dependencies twice.
python -c 'import pathlib, tomllib, subprocess, sys; requirements = tomllib.loads(pathlib.Path("pyproject.toml").read_text())["project"]["optional-dependencies"]["pronunciation"]; all(isinstance(item, str) and item.strip() for item in requirements) and requirements or sys.exit("pronunciation extra must contain requirements"); subprocess.check_call([sys.executable, "-m", "pip", "install", "-q", *requirements])'
PYTHONPATH=src python -c "import pypinyin"
